title: Passenger ride-compose draft persistence
status: IMPLEMENTED — local automated tests green; physical/staging verification not performed
gap: Mid-compose passenger work (pickup/destination points, search text, category, service type, offer draft) was lost on process death or navigation away. No roadmap item covered compose resilience.

implementation.model: mobile/lib/features/ride/domain/models/ride_compose_draft.dart — JSON round-trip, corruption-tolerant tryFromJson (returns null on malformed/missing fields), 24h staleness rule (isStaleAt). Stores: endpoint points {lat,lng,address,source,confirmed}, endpoint text, categoryId, serviceType, passengerOfferDraftText, savedAt.
implementation.store: mobile/lib/features/ride/data/secure_ride_compose_draft_store.dart — SecureStorage-backed, uid-scoped key, malformed payload → null + clears corrupt entry. Mirrors the saved-places persistence pattern.
implementation.vm: ride_request_view_model.dart — (1) _restoreComposeDraft fires async at build; applies ONLY while compose is pristine (any passenger input or deep-link seed wins); bumps all search/resolve generations; refetches pricing when the restored draft is already submittable; stale drafts discarded + cleared. (2) _scheduleDraftPersist — 600ms debounced writes across all mutation paths (location select, map-pin, text, confirm, category/service, offer draft, retries). (3) Draft cleared on emptied compose and on successful createRide. (4) No authenticated uid → zero store interaction.

invariants: Pricing snapshots are never persisted nor trusted — estimates always refetch fresh after restore.
Restored confirmed endpoints restore as confirmed; a fresh estimate is still required before submit (existing pricing-invalidated guard).
Draft restores into pristine compose only — user input and deep-link seeds always take precedence.
uid read fresh at write time — a mid-session account switch cannot persist under the previous uid.
Corrupt/stale drafts decode to null and are cleared, never partially applied.
Coordinates persisted verbatim; naming state rides on the stored address string only.
self_audit_fixes: Restore built next-state from a snapshot taken before _invalidatePricing() — rebuilt on post-invalidation state to avoid resurrecting cleared pricing fields.
Uid was cached in _draftUid — replaced with a fresh ref.read at each write/clear so account switches cannot leak drafts across keys.

tests_run.test/features/ride/ride_compose_draft_te: 9/9 PASS — model round-trip, corrupt/partial decode, staleness boundary; store round-trip, uid isolation, corrupt tolerance, clear; VM restore, stale discard, non-pristine precedence, debounced persist shape, no-uid no-op

verification_boundary.physical_device: NOT RUN — no process-death smoke performed; SM-A325F adb link unstable in prior session
verification_boundary.staging: NOT APPLICABLE — pure client/secure-storage feature; staging still down (GCP billing disabled)
verification_boundary.cloud_cost: zero — no billing changes, no paid services, no deployments

limitations: Draft restore requires an authenticated uid at VM build — signed-out compose is not persisted.
24h TTL is a fixed freshness policy; no user-visible 'resume draft' affordance distinction (restore is silent).
Physical process-death round-trip on the Samsung device not yet demonstrated.
next_step: Optional: bounded on-device process-death smoke (kill app mid-compose, relaunch, confirm restore) once the SM-A325F adb link is stable; then live ride-state push verification once billing restores.
